tasks.instruction: Do podanych nazwisk podroznikow (1.1.-1.5.) dopasuj opisy ich dokonan (A-I). Cztery opisy zostaly podane dodatkowo i nie odnosza sie do zadnej osoby.

options.text: the first Englishman to sail around the world
the leader of the Endurance expedition to Antarctica
the missionary who explored the Zambezi in Africa
the first man to reach the South Pole
one of the first two men to reach the summit of Everest
the navigator who first sailed around the Cape of Good Hope
the naturalist who sailed on HMS Beagle
the first European to cross Australia from south to north
the first European to reach the east coast of Australia
